spanish: Y hizo Jehová así, y vino enjambre pesado a casa de Faraón y casa de sus siervos; y en toda tierra de Egipto se corrompía la tierra de faces del enjambre.

findings.issue: «de faces» turns min + plural-construct face into a genitive on «la tierra» (the land of faces), and does not keep the adverbial from-the-face-of the swarm as what the ruin is from.

notes: Remaining clauses match person, number, the directional house, the names, and the break after his servants.
